Every package below belongs to the Go module `example.com/widgets`.

## Packages

- [lib/gadget](/docs/reference/go-api/gadget/): Package gadget holds widgets.
- [lib/sub/deep](/docs/reference/go-api/sub-deep/): Package deep is nested two levels down.
- [lib/widget](/docs/reference/go-api/widget/): Package widget makes widgets.
